market_definition: Silane Coupling Agents comprises organosilane products used to improve interfacial bonding between inorganic surfaces and organic polymers in adhesives, sealants, composites and related formulations. The market covers coupling-agent products sold as ingredients or surface treatments. By Functional Group • Amino Silanes • Epoxy Silanes • Methacrylate Silanes • Vinyl Silanes • Sulfur Silanes By Product Form • Liquid • Pre-Hydrolyzed • Supported / Formulated By Application • Adhesives and Sealants • Composites • Coatings • Rubber • Glass-Fiber Treatment By Function • Adhesion Enhancement • Moisture Resistance • Mechanical Strength • Coupling and Crosslinking By End Use • Automotive • Construction • Electronics • Renewable Energy • Industrial Materials By Region • North America • Europe • Asia Pacific • Latin America • Middle East • Africa EXCLUDED from the market: Finished adhesives and sealants, bulk silicone polymers, general-purpose solvents and non-silane coupling agents. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor.
